definitions.explanation: A form of stand-up comedy performed by a single person, featuring humorous stories and observations. A traditional Japanese comedic performance art.
Informal, lighthearted conversation without a specific purpose or structure.

examples.japanese: {漫談|まんだん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{笑|わら}わせる→笑う：00685_warau⟧。
examples.english: To make the audience laugh with a comic monologue.
His comic talks often draw on current events.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寄席|よせ}→寄席：12389_yose⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{漫談|まんだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{披露|ひろう}する→披露する：20927_hirousuru⟧。
examples.english: To perform a comic monologue at a variety theater.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦はず→はず：01557_hazu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{漫談|まんだん}になった。
examples.english: What was supposed to be a meeting turned into idle chat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{漫談|まんだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{付|つ}き{合|あ}う→付き合う：02291_tsukiau⟧。
examples.english: To humor a senior's rambling talk.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧そっちのけ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{漫談|まんだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: Work talk was set aside and the casual chatting continued.

notes:
Composed of {漫|まん} (rambling, random) + {談|だん} (talk). As a performance art, {漫談|まんだん} is a solo comedy form distinct from ⟦{漫才|まんざい}→漫才：04458_manzai⟧ (which uses a duo). As everyday vocabulary, it describes aimless, lighthearted chatter.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {漫談|まんだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{披露|ひろう}する→披露する：20927_hirousuru⟧: to perform a comic monologue
- {漫談|まんだん}{家|か}: comic monologuist, comedic talker
- {漫談|まんだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to turn into idle chat

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{漫才|まんざい}→漫才：04458_manzai⟧: manzai — two-person comedy with a straight man and funny man
- ⟦{落語|らくご}→落語：04457_rakugo⟧: rakugo — traditional seated storytelling by a single performer using props
- ⟦{雑談|ざつだん}→雑談：06639_zatsudan⟧: small talk, chat — the most common neutral word for casual conversation
